cases.name: distribution-normal
cases.description: normal spends two draws a row, by Box-Muller
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="normal" mean="170" sd="10" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-lognormal
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="lognormal" meanlog="10" sdlog="1" decimals="0"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-exponential
cases.description: exponential, one draw by inverse CDF
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="exponential" rate="0.5" decimals="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-pareto
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="pareto" alpha="1.5" xmin="100" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-weibull
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="weibull" shape="2" scale="5" decimals="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-poisson
cases.description: poisson samples a cumulative table by binary search
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="poisson" lambda="4"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-zipf
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="zipf" n="20" s="1.2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-gamma
cases.description: gamma has no closed-form inverse and is inverted numerically
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="gamma" shape="2" scale="3" decimals="4"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-beta
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="beta" alpha="2" beta="5" decimals="5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: distribution-clipped
cases.description: min and max clip the sample rather than redrawing it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" distribution="normal" mean="0" sd="1" decimals="1" min="-1" max="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: timeseries-trend
cases.description: A trend-only series takes no draws at all
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="timeseries" base="100" trend="2" decimals="0"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: timeseries-seasonal
cases.description: A seasonal wave repeats on its period
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="timeseries" base="100" trend="0.5" period="4" amplitude="10" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: timeseries-noise
cases.description: Noise costs two draws a row
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="timeseries" base="50" noise="3" decimals="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: missing-token
cases.description: missing blanks a row with the token it was given
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="a,b,c,d,e,f" percent="100,,,,," missing="0.4" missing_as="NULL"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: anomaly-spike
cases.description: anomaly multiplies the values it selects
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="1..9" anomaly="0.3" anomaly_factor="10"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
